minecraft:scaffolding: A quick climbing frame made from bamboo and string. Jump to climb up, sneak to climb down, and break the bottom to bring the whole tower down. It can extend a few blocks out from its support.
minecraft:redstone: Red dust that carries redstone power, like wire. Place it on the ground to connect switches, lamps and machines. It is also used in brewing to make effects last longer.
minecraft:redstone_torch: A torch that gives off redstone power. It turns off when the block it sits on is powered, which makes it the classic signal inverter. It gives a little light too.
minecraft:redstone_block: Nine redstone dust in a block. It is a permanent power source that can't be switched off. Pistons can move it, which makes it useful in flying machines.
minecraft:repeater: A redstone component that boosts a signal back to full strength. Right-click it to add a delay of up to four ticks. A powered repeater pointing into its side locks it.
minecraft:comparator: A redstone component that compares signals or measures how full a container is. Right-click it to switch between compare and subtract mode. Builders use it for item sorters and clocks.
minecraft:piston: A block that pushes up to twelve blocks when powered. It can't push obsidian, bedrock or blocks with containers. Add a slimeball to make a sticky piston.
minecraft:sticky_piston: A piston with a slimeball on its face. It pushes blocks when powered and pulls them back when unpowered. It is the heart of most hidden doors.
minecraft:slime_block: A bouncy green block made from nine slimeballs. You bounce off it instead of taking fall damage. Moved by a piston, it drags neighbouring blocks along.
minecraft:honey_block: A sticky block made from four honey bottles. It slows you down, stops you jumping and lets you slide slowly down its sides. Pistons can use it to move blocks, but it won't stick to slime.
minecraft:observer: A redstone component that watches the block in front of it. When that block changes, it sends a short pulse out of its back. It powers many crop farms.
minecraft:hopper: A funnel made from five iron ingots and a chest. It pulls items from above and pushes them into the container it points at. A redstone signal locks it.
minecraft:dispenser: A block that uses or fires items when powered. It shoots arrows and fire charges, places water and lava, and equips armor on players in front of it. Craft it from cobblestone, a bow and redstone.
minecraft:dropper: A block that drops an item out of its face when powered. Pointed into a container, it moves items instead. Craft it from seven cobblestone and redstone.
